caption: The drawing features a single wooden object placed against a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a flat, elongated rectangular board with a split or fork at one end, forming two parallel prongs. The surface of the wood is textured with visible grain and areas of shading, indicating a natural brown color with variations from light to dark. The prongs are slightly rounded at the tips, and the board is supported by a block-like leg affixed perpendicular to the underside at the wider end. The overall composition is simple, with the object positioned diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. There are no other objects or details present in the drawing, and the background remains unadorned.
title: Bootjack
